description: Provision an AWS Ec2 VPCEndpointServiceConfiguration via the ACK ec2 controller. Fields mirror the ec2.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1 VPCEndpointServiceConfiguration spec.

acceptanceRequired.description:
Indicates whether requests from service consumers to create an endpoint to
your service must be accepted manually.

allowedPrincipals.description:
The Amazon Resource Names (ARN) of the principals. Permissions are granted
to the principals in this list. To grant permissions to all principals, specify
an asterisk (*).

gatewayLoadBalancerARNs.description: The Amazon Resource Names (ARNs) of the Gateway Load Balancers.

networkLoadBalancerARNs.description: The Amazon Resource Names (ARNs) of the Network Load Balancers.

privateDNSName.description:
(Interface endpoint configuration) The private DNS name to assign to the
VPC endpoint service.

region.description: AWS region for this resource (e.g. eu-west-1). Rendered as the services.k8s.aws/region annotation. Empty inherits the ACK controller's default region.
region.title: AWS region

supportedIPAddressTypes.description: The supported IP address types. The possible values are ipv4 and ipv6.

tags.description:
The tags. The value parameter is required, but if you don't want the tag
to have a value, specify the parameter with no value, and we set the value
to an empty string.

title: AWS Ec2 VPCEndpointServiceConfiguration
